subject: Integrator technical sprint — prep and ops plan
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Liu <evan.liu@blueskyconsulting.com>, Nina Patel <nina.patel@blueskyconsulting.com>
Cc: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Integrator technical sprint — proposed dates and preflight

Hi Evan / Nina —

Thanks again for the time last week. We took notes and sketched a proposal for a 3-day Integrator Technical Sprint to accelerate BlueSky's first joint delivery with Redwood. Goal is to leave the sprint with a validated end-to-end lab (Redwood model -> BlueSky connector -> sample app), documented runbook, and a follow-up MOP for your implementation teams.

Proposed dates: Aug 10–12 (US Pacific). High-level objectives:
- Day 1: environment setup + model validation (quantized variant)
- Day 2: connector troubleshooting + observability hooks
- Day 3: runbook handoff + smoke tests and success criteria

Pre-req asks for your side (quick):
1) Confirm 3 technical attendees (eng + infra + PM)
2) Temporary AWS account/access or a sandbox VPC we can use for the lab
3) Any IP/contract redlines that would block hands-on work (we can run under an NDA if needed)

We plan to provide detailed sandbox instructions and an agenda by Wed. Attaching a brief ops checklist (will follow). Do you have any hard blockers on the proposed dates?

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
+1 (555) 210-4421
From: Evan Liu <evan.liu@blueskyconsulting.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Nina Patel <nina.patel@blueskyconsulting.com>, camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integrator technical sprint — proposed dates and preflight

Jonas —

Appreciate the plan. Aug 10–12 works for the core delivery team. Tentative attendees: myself (eng lead), Nina (product), and Ravi Kumar (infra) — I will confirm Ravi by EOD tomorrow.

Questions/notes:
- VPN/VPC access: we typically cannot give external teams persistent creds. Can Redwood work with a temporary AWS account or with a jumpbox pattern?
- Compliance: we need a short SOC2/PII note on what data will be used in the sandbox (likely anonymized sample data).
- Licensing: who signs the temporary license for the runtime? Is a simple MSA addendum sufficient?

If you can send the sandbox instructions + a one-pager success criteria doc, I’ll route to procurement and infra.

— Evan
Evan Liu
Principal Engineer, BlueSky Consulting
evan.liu@blueskyconsulting.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Liu <evan.liu@blueskyconsulting.com>, Nina Patel <nina.patel@blueskyconsulting.com>
Cc: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integrator technical sprint — proposed dates and preflight

Evan — great, thanks. Quick answers inline and attachments included.

- Access model: We can provision a temporary AWS account in your org (preferred) or provide a Redwood-managed sandbox account scoped to the sprint. For sensitive customers we use the jumpbox pattern; for this hands-on sprint we recommend the temporary account for speed.
- Data: we only need anonymized sample payloads. I’m attaching a short compliance note (SOC2 scope + no PII stored).
- Licensing: we can run under a 30-day temporary evaluation license; I’ll include a one‑page addendum for signature.

Attachments attached to this thread: bluesky-sandbox-instructions.pdf (step-by-step access + IAM policy), integrator-sprint-agenda.xlsx (detailed day-by-day), mop-runbook.md (expected outputs and runbook template).

Success criteria (short):
1) End-to-end inference call from your connector to a Redwood-hosted model with latency < 250ms p50 in our lab network
2) Automated smoke test (3 scenarios) in the runbook passing on Day 3
3) Signed MOP that captures the handoff steps for your delivery teams

Next steps:
1) Evan confirms the final attendee list and whether you want a Redwood-managed sandbox or a temporary AWS account (we can provision by Friday)
2) Camila will drop the provisioning ticket and the DocuSign link for the addendum

Link to shared folder with materials: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cBlueskySprintShared
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/contact/BS-117

If that all looks good I’ll ask Product to join a 30-minute preflight call next Tue to walk the agenda.

Thanks,
Jonas
From: camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: jonas.weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integrator technical sprint — provisioning note (internal)

Jonas / Soojin —

FYI: I opened the provisioning ticket with infra (INC-4527). We can spin a scoped AWS account by Fri EOD assuming Evan confirms. I also uploaded the sandbox IAM policy stub to the shared folder and added a short runbook template for day 2 debugging exercises.

Action items I’m taking:
- Create AWS account and seed with temp keys (rotate on close)
- Prepare the DocuSign addendum and route to Evan
- Schedule the Product preflight call for Tue July 28 at 10am PT (tentative)

Will update the thread when the account is ready.

— Camila
Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Evan Liu <evan.liu@blueskyconsulting.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Nina Patel <nina.patel@blueskyconsulting.com>, camila_reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integrator technical sprint — provisioning note (confirming)

Thanks Jonas / Camila —

We’ll take the Redwood-managed sandbox for speed. Confirmed attendees: Evan Liu (eng lead), Nina Patel (product), Ravi Kumar (infra). We reviewed the attachments and the compliance note — looks fine from our side; procurement asked for the addendum + DocuSign link which you mentioned.

DocuSign is fine; please send the link and we’ll get signatures by Monday. Also please add a short section in the MOP for who is responsible for post-sprint support (BlueSky ops vs Redwood support window).

Looking forward to Tuesday’s preflight.

— Evan
